description: Start recording this session's phone actions as a Maestro flow (YAML). From now until record_stop, every successful open_app, tap, long_press, type_text, swipe, press_key, wait_for, take_screenshot and run_task becomes a step; reads are not steps. A tap by node is written as a tap by the text, resource id or description that node showed. Call it before open_app, so the flow starts by launching the app, and before driving a test case by hand, so run_flow can repeat it later without you.

device.description: Which paired phone runs this: its id, or its model or part of it, as codedroid_devices lists them. Required when several phones are paired.

name.description: What the flow is for, e.g. the test case id. Written into the file.

name: record_start
title: Start recording a flow
